practice: In her artistic practice, Natalia works with sculpture, installation, objects, video art and sound, examining the mechanisms behind visual expression and the boundaries of the visible.
subject: Her research focuses on visual strategies of omission, practices of veiling, and processes of censorship and information concealment—both in physical urban environments and in digital space. Through the delicate deconstruction of everyday and technological contexts, the artist studies mechanisms of concealment, distortion and the partial removal of images.
method: Her primary method is field observation, data collection and systematization. Working at the intersection of material and audiovisual art, she constructs a complex system of traces and gaps, revealing hidden subtexts and invisible structures that shape contemporary perception.
